title: Map: Tracking OpenAI's leadership exodus

content_html:
Jacob Robbins

Thu, August 13, 2026 at 6:17 PM CDT 1 min read

Fidji Simo. Kevin Weil. Brad Lightcap.

And on Thursday, Denise Dresser, OpenAI's revenue chief, announced her departure, joining the slew of senior leaders who have left the company.

In a LinkedIn post, Dresser wrote, "I made the difficult decision to leave OpenAI in the coming weeks to pursue other opportunities." OpenAI has hired the former president and chief operating officer of Wiz, Dali Rajic, to replace Dresser.

It's an eyebrow-raising trend for the company's IPO and business prospects as it tries to catch up with its rival Anthropic.

"Leaving after less than a year is interesting because she was hired to turn their product demand into a durable enterprise revenue organization, which requires continuous effort," said Harrison Rolfes, a senior research analyst at PitchBook who covers the major AI frontier labs. "If this repeated turnover continues to happen, it will make the organizational execution required for an IPO harder and something investors will likely watch closer now."

Sign up for The Daily Pitch newsletter Subscribe

Just a year ago, a PitchBook analysis found that over 25% of OpenAI's research talent had left the company. That exodus now appears to be hitting OpenAI's senior executives hard, with 25 executives leaving the company since January 2024.

The following data visualization charts the scope and breadth of the exit from OpenAI, using public disclosures and PitchBook data.

content_html_zh:
雅各布·罗宾斯

2026 年 8 月 13 日星期四下午 6:17 CDT 阅读 1 分钟

菲吉·西莫。 凯文·威尔. 布拉德·莱特卡普。

周四，OpenAI 营收主管丹尼斯·德莱瑟 (Denise Dresser) 宣布离职，加入众多离开公司的高级领导者行列。

在 LinkedIn 的一篇帖子中，德莱瑟写道：“我做出了一个艰难的决定，在未来几周内离开 OpenAI，去寻求其他机会。” OpenAI 已聘请 Wiz 前总裁兼首席运营官 Dali Rajic 接替 Dresser。

在该公司试图追赶其竞争对手 Anthropic 之际，这对于该公司的 IPO 和业务前景来说是一个令人惊讶的趋势。

PitchBook 负责主要人工智能前沿实验室的高级研究分析师哈里森·罗尔夫斯 (Harrison Rolfes) 表示：“不到一年后离开很有趣，因为她受聘的目的是将他们的产品需求转变为持久的企业收入组织，这需要持续的努力。” “如果这种反复的人员流动继续发生，这将使首次公开募股所需的组织执行变得更加困难，投资者现在可能会更加密切地关注这一点。”

订阅 The Daily Pitch 时事通讯

就在一年前，PitchBook 的一项分析发现，OpenAI 超过 25% 的研究人才已经离开公司。 现在，这种离职似乎对 OpenAI 的高管造成了沉重打击，自 2024 年 1 月以来，已有 25 名高管离开公司。
